info.name: Marp Slides
info.summary: Turn a prompt into a PPTX slide deck
info.description: Turn a user prompt into a slide deck. A language model authors Marp Markdown from the prompt; the deck is built as an editable PPTX (default, native shapes, images via provided files), a standalone HTML presentation or a PDF document, with speaker notes (PDF output excludes them) and the Markdown source retained.

variable.name: MARP_SLIDES_POLL_INTERVAL
variable.description: How often the ExApp polls Nextcloud for new slide deck tasks when no trigger event has arrived. Default: 5.

variable.name: MARP_SLIDES_MARP_TIMEOUT
variable.description: Timeout for each marp-cli conversion subprocess (HTML validation and PPTX rendering each). Default: 120.

variable.name: MARP_SLIDES_LLM_TIMEOUT
variable.description: Maximum time to wait for the nested core:text2text task that authors the deck Markdown. Default: 300.

variable.name: MARP_SLIDES_TOTAL_LLM_TIMEOUT
variable.description: Total time budget across BOTH inner LLM attempts (the first plus the self-correcting retry). Default: 480.

variable.name: MARP_SLIDES_LOG_EXCERPT
variable.description: When a generated deck fails validation, log a 240-character excerpt of the extracted markdown (WARNING, deck content only) for diagnosability. Set to false to suppress the excerpt in privacy-sensitive deployments; the error line itself is always logged. Default: true.
